I am a 52-year-old woman in Kagera with some schooling, and this 0.28-hectare plot is too small to buy a full bag of fertilizer that would go to waste, so I will not spend cash on inorganic fertilizer this season. I will carry manure from my homestead and spread it here because the land is mine and I want to keep it fertile without spending money. I saved local seed from last season's harvest, and I will plant that instead of buying improved seed that I cannot afford right now. For labor, I will work this plot myself with family for about twenty-five days over the season — clearing, planting, weeding twice, and harvesting — and I will not hire anyone because the plot is small and cash is tight.
